## Checks

Tick what applies; explain anything you can't tick. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`).
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`, and `bun run test` pass.
- [ ] `bun run e2e` passes, if the change touches a flow it covers.
- [ ] New behaviour has tests.
- [ ] New user-facing text is in `apps/web/src/i18n/ar.ts`, and the screen works right to left on a phone.
- [ ] No secrets, phone numbers, or invite codes from real people in code, tests, or screenshots.
- [ ] `docs/deploy.md` is updated if this needs a new environment variable, secret, or deploy step.
